diagnosis: reopen_archived_invoice allows transitioning invoices from 'archived' back to 'active' using a StatusField choice. The view relies on get_object_or_404(BillingInvoice, uuid=invoice_uuid) without confirming that invoice.business == request.user.business. Any authenticated business customer can reactivate and modify archived invoices belonging to other businesses.

Host: billing.accountingapp.net
Cookie: sessionid=vendor_session_33
Accept: application/json
